claims.claim: 在 IEEE 754 binary64 中，0.1 + 0.2 的求值结果是 0.30000000000000004；Python、JavaScript、C、Java 的实机输出一致。

sources.title: Python 3 documentation — Floating Point Arithmetic: Issues and Limitations

claims.verification: Ran Python 3.14, Node v24, cc and java on this machine: all four returned 0.30000000000000004 and false for == 0.3. Outputs in evidence/verification.txt.
claims.caveat: binary64 / double precision. binary32 gives a different printed result.

sources.title: Goldberg, What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic (1991)

claims.verification: Printed the exact stored value with Python's Decimal(0.1) and compared to the documented binary expansion.
claims.caveat: The decimal expansion is exact for the stored double, not for mathematical 0.1.

claims.claim: binary64 使用 1 位符号、11 位指数、52 位存储尾数；加上隐含的最高位 1，有效数字共 53 位。
claims.verification: Cross-checked the field widths and the implicit leading bit against the IEEE 754 binary64 format description.
claims.caveat: Subnormals do not have the same implicit leading 1; 0.1 is normal.

sources.title: Goldberg, What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic (1991)

claims.verification: Long division of 1/10 in base 2 reaches the repeating remainder 0110; the first digits are 0.0001100110011….
claims.caveat: The stored value is a rounded truncation of this infinite expansion.

claims.verification: Ran the exact expression in Python 3.14 on this machine; output recorded in evidence/verification.txt.
claims.caveat: Python's shortest repr and hex() expose the same stored double in different forms.

claims.claim: math.isclose 的默认相对容差是 1e-09。
claims.verification: Read the documented default rel_tol=1e-09 and ran math.isclose(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3) -> True.
claims.caveat: isclose is not a universal equality test; choose a tolerance that matches the domain.

claims.verification: Computed the subtraction in Python and compared it with the spacing of binary64 numbers near 0.3 (2^-54).
claims.caveat: 1 ulp is a local unit; its absolute size depends on the exponent.

claims.claim: 在默认 28 位十进制精度的上下文里，Decimal('0.1') + Decimal('0.2') 等于 Decimal('0.3')。
claims.verification: Ran Decimal('0.1') + Decimal('0.2') == Decimal('0.3') -> True with default context.
claims.caveat: Decimal arithmetic still has a finite context precision; it is not symbolic mathematics.

claims.claim: Python、JavaScript、C、Java 在各自默认的 IEEE 754 binary64 下得到相同的 0.30000000000000004。
claims.verification: Ran equivalent programs in Python 3.14, Node v24, C (cc) and Java on this machine; all printed 0.30000000000000004 and false for equality with 0.3.
claims.caveat: Some languages or build flags may use extended precision or binary32; the claim is about the default binary64 path.

claims.claim: 53 位二进制有效数字大约对应 15–17 位十进制有效数字。
claims.verification: 53 * log10(2) ≈ 15.95; the Python tutorial describes binary64 as 53 bits of precision, about 15–17 decimal digits.
claims.caveat: The exact number of reliable decimal digits depends on the value and the direction of rounding.

analogies.text: 像一把刻度固定的小数尺，只能量到有限的格子。
analogies.maps: 尾数只有 52 位存储位，加上隐含的 1 共 53 位有效数字。
analogies.breaks: 浮点数不是固定小数点：指数会让格子的绝对间距随数量级变化，所以它更像一把可以缩放的尺。

analogies.text: 像一本只有 53 行的记事本，写不下的部分只能四舍五入。
analogies.maps: 每次存储和运算都要把结果舍入到最近的可表示值。
analogies.breaks: 记事本的比喻暗示“写满就停”，而浮点还会用指数移动小数点；舍入规则也是 ties-to-even，不是简单的四舍五入。
